data.modules#Modules:
The modules of go-mswin listed here. Each links to its source and to its generated API reference.
Module Reference d3d11 pkg.go.dev screencapture pkg.go.dev webauthn pkg.go.dev win32 pkg.go.dev winrt pkg.go.dev d3d11 (v0.2.0) is a pure-Go binding of the part of Direct3D 11 that a compute kernel needs, with package dxgi alongside; COM is reached through syscall, with no cgo. It has run only on WARP, the software rasterizer of a Windows CI runner, and on no GPU.
webauthn (v0.5.0) asks Windows to authenticate somebody with a security key through webauthn.dll, with no cgo. Since v0.5.0 it carries the hmac-secret and credProtect extensions (RegisterRequest.HMACSecret, RegisterRequest.CredProtect, Request.HMACSalts), which theca v0.8.0 uses for FIDO2 on Windows. hmac-secret needs WebAuthn API version 6; on an older Windows the call fails with ErrUnsupported. Verified on Windows (API version 9): the struct layouts and the read-back helpers. Not verified: a call against a real key.
Descriptions live on the repositories themselves rather than being copied here, so there is one place to correct when one changes.
